name: Strawberry guava
desc: Cattley guava (Psidium cattleianum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 27 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Psidium cattleyanum, commonly known as Cattley guava, strawberry guava or cherry guava, is a small tree (2–6 m (6 ft 7 in – 19 ft 8 in) tall) in the Myrtaceae (myrtle) family.
